# Example Company

> Example Company makes invoicing software for freelancers and small agencies in India and the UK.

Key facts: founded 2019 · head office Pune, India · plans from INR 0 (free tier) · support in English and Hindi.

## Product
- [Features](https://example.com/features/): what the product does, by use case
- [Pricing](https://example.com/pricing/): plans, limits and currencies
- [Integrations](https://example.com/integrations/): supported banks, payment gateways and accounting tools

## Docs
- [Getting started](https://example.com/docs/getting-started/): set up an account and send a first invoice
- [API reference](https://example.com/docs/api/): REST endpoints and authentication

## Company
- [About](https://example.com/about/): team, history and contact details
- [Customers](https://example.com/customers/): case studies with results

## Policies
- [Privacy policy](https://example.com/privacy/)
- [Terms of service](https://example.com/terms/)

## Optional
- [Blog](https://example.com/blog/): guides on invoicing, taxes and getting paid
- [Changelog](https://example.com/changelog/): dated product updates
